# PingThat

> Free, privacy-first suite of 17 network and security tools for developers and sysadmins. DNS lookup, SSL checker, WHOIS, HTTP headers inspector, JWT decoder, subnet calculator, IP converter, email authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), port scan, WebRTC leak test, and more. Every tool runs in your browser with no tracking. Built on Astro + Svelte 5.

## IP & geolocation

- [What Is My IP](https://pingthat.dev/my-ip/): Public IPv4 and IPv6 address with ISP, country, city, ASN
- [IP Converter](https://pingthat.dev/ip-converter/): Convert IPv4 between decimal, binary, hex, octal, and integer formats
- [Subnet Calculator](https://pingthat.dev/subnet-calculator/): Network address, broadcast, host range, mask, and wildcard from any CIDR block

## DNS & domains

- [DNS Lookup](https://pingthat.dev/dns-lookup/): A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA, CAA records from public resolvers
- [WHOIS Lookup](https://pingthat.dev/whois-lookup/): Registrar, creation/expiry, nameservers, DNSSEC status
- [Email Authentication](https://pingthat.dev/email-auth/): Check SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records for any domain

## HTTP & web

- [HTTP Headers](https://pingthat.dev/http-headers/): Inspect response headers including security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options)
- [Redirect Checker](https://pingthat.dev/redirect-checker/): Trace redirect chains with status codes and cookies
- [URL Parser](https://pingthat.dev/url-parser/): Decompose any URL into protocol, host, path, query, and fragment
- [Is It Down](https://pingthat.dev/is-it-down/) / [Is It Up](https://pingthat.dev/is-it-up/): Check website availability and response time

## Security

- [SSL Checker](https://pingthat.dev/ssl-checker/): Certificate chain, SAN list, issuer, expiry, key algorithm
- [Port Scan](https://pingthat.dev/port-scan/): Check which common ports are reachable on a host
- [Password Strength](https://pingthat.dev/password-strength/): zxcvbn-based strength scoring — password never leaves your browser
- [JWT Decoder](https://pingthat.dev/jwt-decoder/): Decode JWT header and payload client-side; token never leaves your browser
- [WebRTC Leak Test](https://pingthat.dev/webrtc-leak-test/): Detect IP exposure through WebRTC ICE candidates behind a VPN
- [Privacy Check](https://pingthat.dev/privacy-check/): Audit your browser's privacy settings, tracking protection, and fingerprint

## About

PingThat runs every lookup, decoder, and test entirely in the browser. IP geolocation and DNS queries use public APIs; the results stay in your browser — we don't log, cache, or forward queries. JWT tokens and passwords never leave the client. AI training bots are blocked; citation bots (ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot) are allowed.
